messages.body:
Strategy, psychology, and whatever you throw at us. Reply with your question.

Hi Marcus,

This Thursday at 4PM EDT I'm doing our first Cedarline Q&A live on Kingsley!

Join me for psychological takes on the most pressing questions entrepreneurs are facing right now. You send the questions, we'll answer them on air.

If you've caught one of these before you know what they turn into...

Last time we covered:

- Breaking down big goals when you don't know what moves the needle yet
- Process goals vs outcome goals, and which one you should be setting
- Why consistency alone doesn't get you traction
- Perfectionism vs flying by the seat of your pants
- When taking on business debt is smart, and when it isn't
- The surprising case against hiring a VA

The best sessions come from specific questions about a real situation you're in...

Growth, pricing, hiring, focus, procrastination, a decision you keep circling.

Anything in that territory!

Two things to do now:

- Reply to this email with your questions. Even rough ones. We'll work through as many as we can and the ones sent in advance go first.
- Click here to add it to your calendar (https://d2xd1Q04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/calendar-invite) and we'll send you the link on the day.

See you Thursday.

David

Focus Velocity Media, 612 N Maple Ave, Suite 205, Boulder, Colorado
